opening.title: Growth and Performance Marketing Lead
opening.summary: Own measurable growth: acquisition, conversion, referrals and paid campaigns, judged on signups and active customers rather than reach.
opening.about:
We want more of the right people using Nasfam Pay, and we want to know exactly which effort brought them. This role owns that: where customers come from, what makes them sign up, what makes them transact, and what brings them back.

You will run growth as a series of experiments with clear measures, work with the product and content side to fix what loses people, and decide where our marketing money goes.
owns: Paid acquisition across the channels that work for Nigerian crypto and payments customers.
The signup and first-transaction funnel, and the experiments that improve it.
Creator and referral campaigns, with attribution attached to each one.
The growth dashboard the team uses to decide what to do next.
responsibilities: Plan, launch and measure campaigns, and stop the ones that do not pay back.
Set up and maintain attribution so every campaign can be judged on results.
Work with content and community to turn what customers respond to into repeatable formats.
Report weekly on what moved, what did not, and what you will try next.
requirements: A track record of growth work you can show with numbers: what you changed and what it did.
Hands-on experience running paid campaigns and reading their results honestly.
Comfort with analytics: funnels, cohorts, attribution and their limits.
Clear writing and the judgement to say when something did not work.
niceToHave: Experience marketing a fintech, crypto or consumer app in Nigeria.
Experience managing creator or influencer partnerships.
SQL or spreadsheet modelling for campaign economics.
success: Within your first month, every active campaign has attribution and a cost per result we trust.
Within your first quarter, at least one experiment has measurably improved signups or first transactions.
Marketing spend is decided by evidence, with a clear record of what was tried.

questions.label: Describe one growth experiment you ran and how you measured whether it worked.
